svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Review system containers
svg.desc: The new review subsystem end to end: the workflow's jobs, the osf CLI entry points, the in-process review core, the coding agents it drives, and the GitHub API it reads and posts to.
